Subject: Kickoff: Supplier financial setup & invoice routing — ACH vs Wire

Hi Carlos —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off financial onboarding with us. To make sure payments are processed smoothly once production starts, can you confirm the following so we can finish vendor setup on our side?

1) Preferred payout method: ACH (USD) or Wire (specify currency). If ACH, please attach a completed ACH form with bank routing/account and a remittance contact.
2) Invoice submission: do you prefer emailed invoices to invoices@zenpack.io, a portal, or EDI? If via email, please confirm exact invoicing address and whether a copy should go to ap@zenpack.io for remittance.
3) Payment terms: standard Net 30? If you need Net 45/Net 60, flag now so we can align on POs.
4) PO requirements: do you require a Redwood PO number on every invoice? If yes, do you accept a single blanket PO or need a PO per invoice/job?
5) Tax / entity docs: attach W-9 (US vendors) or relevant tax form if available.

Attachments we need from your side: W-9 (or equivalent), ACH details (if ACH), and a sample invoice. We will share our Redwood PO template as well.

Goal: complete vendor record and confirm payment flow by this Friday, Sept 3rd, to avoid hold-ups on the first invoice.

Thanks — looped in Ben (account owner) and Marissa (finance ops) who will finalize fields in our AP system.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Laura —

Thanks — quick responses below and I attached the docs you asked for.

• Preferred payout: ACH (USD) is our default for US customers. We can accept USD wires if required for expedited same-day payment.
• Invoice submission: invoices@zenpack.io is the authoritative inbox; please cc ap@zenpack.io for remittance. We do not use an external portal for Redwood.
• Payment terms: Standard Net 30 works. For larger pilots we can discuss Net 45.
• PO requirements: We prefer a PO number on each invoice. A single blanket PO is fine for monthly invoices, but please include the PO on the header.
• Tax docs: Attached W-9 and our ACH details (bank name, routing, account last 4).

Attachments: [ZenPack_W9.pdf (pdf), ZenPack_ACH_Details.pdf (pdf)]

Let me know if you need full account numbers sent via secure channel — we can docusign the bank letter if needed.

Best,
Carlos Mendes
Head of Partnerships
ZenPack Therapeutics

Hi Carlos —

Appreciate the attachments — received the W-9 and the ACH form. We reviewed and will proceed with ACH (USD) as your primary payment rail. A few confirmations to close the loop:

• Vendor record: Redwood will create the vendor entry this afternoon using the W-9 entity name and the ACH details you provided.
• PO handling: For the pilot we'll issue a blanket PO; please include the PO number on the invoice header and in the filename (Redwood_PO_12345_Invoice.pdf).
• Invoice routing: Please send invoices to invoices@zenpack.io and cc ap@zenpack.io. Our AP system will pick them up from that inbox.
• Remittance: Redwood will send remittance advice to ap@zenpack.io after payment is issued; please confirm if you prefer remittance notices to any additional address.
• Payment timing: Net 30 is approved for this engagement. Wire transfers will be used only on request for expedite and may incur processing fees.

I've attached our Redwood_PO_template.xlsx for your billing team and included a DocuSign link if you prefer to sign a bank letter for full account disclosure: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/txn-83921.

Next steps: Laura (finance ops) will mark the vendor as Active in our system once you confirm remittance recipients. Expected first payment run for the pilot: 30 days after receipt of a compliant invoice.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth launch.
